post.summary: Confirm art image upload from Firebase Function (Internal)
post.description: Internal endpoint called by Firebase Functions to confirm an art image has been uploaded. Requires internal API key authentication.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description:
The name of the Art resource.
For example: "users/123/arts/456"

firebaseUid.description:
The Firebase UID of the user who uploaded the image.
This is extracted from upload metadata for authorization validation.

imageUrl.title: The image URL that was uploaded to Firebase Storage

originalFilename.title: Optional: The original file name that was uploaded

contentType.title: Optional: The content type of the uploaded file

fileSize.title: Optional: The size of the uploaded file in bytes

FirebaseFunctionsServiceConfirmArtImageU.title: Request message for confirming art image upload from Firebase Functions

name.title:
The name of the Art resource.
For example: "users/123/arts/456"

imageUrl.description: ImageURL is the art's image URL.

author.title:
The name of the User resource who is the author of the art.
For example: "users/456"

createTime.description: CreatedAt is the art's creation time. Output only.

updateTime.description: UpdatedAt is the art's last update time.

pbArtStatus.description:
- ART_STATUS_UNSPECIFIED: Default unspecified status
 - ART_STATUS_PENDING_IMAGE: Art is created but image is pending upload
 - ART_STATUS_PROCESSING: Image is uploaded and being processed
 - ART_STATUS_COMPLETE: Art is complete with processed image
 - ART_STATUS_FAILED: Processing failed
 - ART_STATUS_ARCHIVED: Art is archived/hidden but not deleted
pbArtStatus.title: Status of the art
